profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
Bachelor in Business Administration from Temple University, Fox School of Business; with major in Management of Information Systems. Ability to consult and communicate efficiently with external vendors, internal customers, and Information Technology infrastructure team colleagues. Demonstrated strong leadership skills in building student associations to perform in cultural events for Non-profit charitable organizations. Utilized entrepreneurial and Photography skills to develop as start-up business ventures.

Extensive knowledge in the entire study life cycle of clinical trials. Trained in SAS and practiced several projects in creating Tables, Listings, Figures, and Data Derivations. Good knowledge of several SDTM conversion projects. Capable of writing Macros and validate and maintain the macro library to use in different programming aspects. Proficient in creating SDTM annotated case report forms, SDTM mapping specifications, developing SDTM domains and validating using open cDisc validator tool to check the SDTM standards

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Provides design, development, maintenance, and support for UHS clinical reporting applications.
•	Uses development/reporting tools including Cerner’s Discern Visual Developer (CCL), Cerner’s MPages client side web interface, Cerner’s Power Insight Business Objects interface, and Discern EKM Developer (Rules). 
•	Performs modifications (system upgrades) to existing programs that will effectively accomplish desired objectives. 
•	Provides programming and technical support. 
•	Coordinates and performs work assignments given in order to meet deadlines and ensures continued progress toward assignment completion.

positions.title: President/Founder
positions.description:
•	Establish project requirements, arrange all proper equipment and supplies, coordinate with videographers, makeup artists, and other professionals as necessary, to resource and deliver Photos on time.
•	Perform negotiation of the fees for photos utilized, as well as obtain documentation rights and copyright permissions to maintain legal compliance.
•	Execute complex photo shoots utilizing various types of lighting effects and including sophisticated photography techniques, to achieve continuous improvement in photographs.
•	Alter, modify, and rework images using digital and computer software manipulation applications, to produce and deliver state of art pictures.
•	Monitor and analyze website traffic patterns on terms of overview, demographics, behavior, and browser technology, and utilize this data to make meaningful improvement to the website content design.

positions.title: EHR Content Deployment Specialist
positions.description:
•Conduct KBM conversion/upgrade process with minimal supervision
•Conduct KBM conversion/upgrade on client’s system in a production environment during non-business hours in coordination with client
•Analyze and identify complex problems within the software and/or a customer’s data and/or the knowledge base.  Then, work in collaboration others to determine the appropriate course of action to be taken based on the analysis performed and all possible solutions
•Identify problem areas and work with others to develop short term action plans and provide input to resolve major customer problems
•Document all analysis and actions for conversion/upgrade calls
•Exercise independent judgment to determine the appropriate course of action (fixes/solutions) to be taken based on the analysis performed and all possible solutions

positions.title: Application Systems Analyst
positions.description:
•	Create, modify and maintain automated processes using MS SQL, Script Runner, and PLSQL Developer to query and retrieve data and present to the Business users for analysis and data mining.
•	Methodically analyze data before and after changes in the operating server environment, to critically determine weaknesses, including errors in processes; and make recommendations to improve performance.
•	Consult with internal customers, and collaborate with vendors and technical infrastructure personnel to respond and resolve day-to-day support calls, and incidents logged in production.
•	Explore new technology, commercial off the shelf software tools and applicable business processes, to share and keep peers and customers informed of market trends; to enable effective business process improvements.

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
•	Analyzed sales reports and district goals to develop better business; collaborated with the store manager to create strategies to increase sales and maximize profits.
•	Supervised sales team of 7 employees to ensure sales floor was properly staffed and sales goals of at least $1,000/person were met
•	Provided exceptional customer service to clients; investigated and resolved customer issues in a timely manner
•	Recognized for ability to consistently achieve and exceed established sales objectives and quotas of $1,500 by maintaining in-depth technical knowledge of all products

positions.title: Project Manager Specialist in Systems Integration
positions.description:
•	Performed cross-functional project responsibilities and author detailed reports with key milestones and deliverables, to maintain accurate weekly Project status reports. 
•	Ensured timely delivery of project status reports to project team, Business stakeholders, and senior management to maintain transparency and clear communication on the project.
•	Coordinated tracking of key project milestones and made recommendations on adjusting project plans and/or resources to drive progress and meet the business needs on time.
•	Presented a thorough analysis of Cloud Computing to the board of CIGNA, and made recommendations which aligned with CIGNA’s enterprise architectural strategy

positions.title: Desktop Support
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented migration of blueprint information of the two parent companies with separate legacy file systems, to configure and build into one central file system.
•	Documented the new file system structure for future reference and easy retrieval of files, when needed.
•	Assisted the Information Technology Operational team by taking on support calls for desktop computer machines, to install new or upgrade software; resolve network issues by resetting users account logins, etc.
